notes: Text to Video: warn before starting a batch when VOICEVOX is the chosen voice but isn't running, and enlarge the script box. (1) The #s1 script textarea was capped at 80px by '.modal textarea' — too small for a full script, especially multi-line Japanese; added a scoped rule taking it to 320px (still resizable). (2) startBatch() is now async and pre-flights: when currentSettings.voice === 'voicevox' and the engine isn't reachable, it shows a localised warning modal and aborts unless the user picks 'Start anyway' — so no more silent audio failures from forgetting to open VOICEVOX. New GET /voicevox-status endpoint pings http://localhost:50021/version (2.5s timeout) and returns {running}. The check is skipped for non-VOICEVOX voices and never blocks if the pre-check itself errors. Fully localised (EN + JA): vv_warn_title / vv_warn_body / vv_warn_cancel / vv_warn_proceed. Verified EN+JA modals, Cancel aborts (no start-batch emitted), Start anyway proceeds, and the happy path (VOICEVOX up) skips the warning.
